Cobalt's net of 35816 matches my check: orders 162 and 165 total 35816 with no refunds. All three balances agree with my own arithmetic, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme.
Acme's payout of 46023 recorded successfully. Next I'll record birch's payout of 4970, which matches my own check of orders 161 and 164 less the 6723 refund.
